validation_notes: Processed 10 unique CSV people for SFIN after merging duplicate Anton Goltsman rows and treating the extra unnamed CSV cell 'Усанин Михаил' as an anomaly rather than a SFIN person. Checked 4 local SFIN documents before web research. Total research rounds: 1 per person plus overview. CEO identified as Igor Sidorov from the 2024 annual report. Education not specifically confirmed for Mikhail Gorbachev beyond 'higher education'; Sidorov's education institution is not disclosed. Weak sources used: MarketScreener for current board/person list because 2024 official AGM disclosure withheld board names; Smart-Lab only as a weak cross-check for Goltsman education/public profile. Conflicts remaining: 2024 official disclosure confirms election of a nine-person board but withholds names under disclosure restrictions, so names are triangulated from CSV, MarketScreener and the official 2022 issuer report. Namesakes rejected: academic/political-science Mikhail Valeryevich Gorbachev profiles, Tatyana Boikova/Boyko scholar profiles, Anton Goltsman MIIGAiK academic lead, and generic Maxim Dmitriev/Vlasov/Alexander Protas profiles without SFI identity anchors. Search considered complete because all local files were checked, official issuer biographies were read, 2024 AGM and annual report were checked, previous employers and education leads were searched, and two search passes did not produce higher-quality public biographies for remaining gaps. ROUND 2 -- QUALITY PASS (2026-08-01): Step 0 git-baseline check confirmed the on-disk file was already byte-identical (modulo CRLF/LF) to git HEAD (commit f973022) -- SFIN was not among the six regressed tickers; no restoration needed. Desync check: no genuine JSON-vs-notes value conflicts were found for this ticker (no person's notes had an unresolved "Contradictions" section describing a JSON-value disagreement); one uncited claim in Boikova_Tatyana_Olegovna_round_1.md ("A101-related companies: board roles in 2021", no source in that file) was investigated fresh and could not be verified, so it was deliberately left OUT of the JSON rather than added on faith -- documented in Boikova's own notes. Simple omissions applied: filled qualification_degree (previously null on all 14 education entries across all 10 people, despite the first pass having added the key) using the fixed ten-value enum, mapped from program/field wording already present and sourced in the JSON itself -- explicit "бакалавриат"/"магистратура"/"бакалавр"/"магистр"/"MBA" wording mapped directly; "экономист"/"юрист" qualification titles combined with a pre-Bologna-era (or transition-era) graduation year mapped to "Specialist degree", matching this exact convention already used 445 times elsewhere in the corpus (e.g. AFKS_person_info.json); a bare "высшее образование" with no level/title stated mapped to "Unknown" (4 entries: Gorbachev's sole entry, Lotarev's Финансовый университет entry, Protas's Горный университет entry); Sidorov's "среднее специальное образование" mapped to "Secondary education" (closest enum fit for a stated secondary/specialized-secondary credential). GICS: 0 pre-existing non-null professional_experience triples existed in this file before this round (all 25 entries were null), so item-2 "correct existing wrong labels" had nothing to check/correct. Under bounded honest-gap-follow-up (item 3), applied GICS to entries where either (a) the organization is this file's own covered company (ПАО "ЭсЭфАй"/its merged trading subsidiary -- copied verbatim from this file's own top-level sector/industry_group/industry) or (b) a confident classification could be made from an established corpus-wide precedent (grepped across output/*.json) or a fresh, verified source: АО "БКС-Банк"/Сбербанк/АКБ "ДОМ.РФ"-"Российский Капитал"/Связь-банк/ВЭБ/ГЛОБЭКС -> Financials/Banks/Banks; ОАО "Мосэнерго" -> Utilities/Utilities/Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers (16 identical corpus precedents); АО "Русский Уголь"/АО "КТК" -> Energy/Energy/Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels (coal producers are Energy not Metals & Mining per this exact corpus's own КТК precedent in MRKP_person_info.json); АО "Росгеология" -> Energy/Energy/Energy Equipment & Services (matches ALRS_person_info.json precedent); АО "Ангстрем-Т" -> Information Technology/Semiconductors & Semiconductor Equipment/Semiconductors & Semiconductor Equipment; НПФ АО "САФМАР"/"Достойное БУДУЩЕЕ" -> Financials/Financial Services (New Name)/Financial Services (New Name); ООО "Агентство недвижимости" -> Real Estate/Real Estate Management & Development (New)/Real Estate Management & Development (New Code). Left deliberately null rather than guessed: ООО "Развитие", ООО "МЛП", СМП Банк/"Парк Легенд", ООО "РК Строй", ООО "Корпоративные инвестиции и технологии", АО "НПК \"Хипроминжиниринг\"", ООО "ЗаряД", ООО "Аспро", ООО "Шанс" (fresh WebFetch/DuckDuckGo queries -- WebSearch tool quota was exhausted session-wide -- found no confirming source for these smaller/ambiguous entities' line of business; each is logged with its specific attempted queries in the relevant person's own `notes` field so a future pass does not repeat the same exhausted angles), and "Самозанятый"/РГСУ correctly left non-classifiable (personal-capacity role; state university, respectively). Depth correction (not new research): three professional_experience rows that had compressed multiple distinct organizations/roles/date-ranges from round-1 research notes into one generic combined row (Boikova's Связь-банк/ВЭБ/ГЛОБЭКС/Росгеология/МЛП row; Vlasov's Сбербанк/Ангстрем-Т/СМП Банк-Парк Легенд/РГСУ/ДОМ.РФ-Российский Капитал/РК Строй row; Protas's Хипроминжиниринг-Росатом/Аспро row) were split into per-organization rows using the exact dates/roles already extracted and sourced in round-1 notes from the same already-cited official issuer report -- no fact was lost, only regrouped with more fidelity, which also made per-organization GICS classification possible. One genuinely new fact found and added with a fresh, directly-fetched source: ООО "ЭсЭфАй трейдинг" (Лотарев's GD role) was reorganized by merger into ПАО "ЭСЭФАЙ" on 14.08.2024 (audit-it.ru company registry record) -- end_year set to 2024 on that entry, resolving the round-1 'remaining gap' about its 2024 status. Other bounded gap-follow-up attempts (Sivachev's post-2021 employer, Мякенький's work history, Горбачев's education institution, Гольцман's exact HSE year, Бойкова's current 2024 employment) all came up empty after fresh queries and remain documented as unresolved in each person's own `notes` field. No previously confirmed fact, description, or source citation was shortened or deleted anywhere this round -- every original fact from the pre-round file is still present, either unchanged or carried into a more granular replacement row. Full detail: research_notes/SFIN/quality_pass_round1_20260801.md.
